simple.meaning: אַמִּיץ (ʼammîyts) is a Hebrew word meaning “strong or (abstractly) strength.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: אַמִּיץ (H533) appears 6 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at 2 Samuel 15:12, with occurrences in 2 Samuel, Job, Isaiah, Amos.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אַמִּיץ (H533) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in אַמִּיץ (H533) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: אַמִּיץ (ʼammîyts) / H533 is traced through 2 Samuel 15:12, Job 9:4, Job 9:19, Isaiah 28:2 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H533. ammits אַמִּיץ (אַמִּץ) adjective mighty — ׳א absolute 2Sam 15:12 2 t.; construct Job 9:4 2 t. — mighty , of Absa-lom's conspiracy 2Sam 15:12 ; elsewhere of persons; as substantive, instrum. of ׳י (i.e. Assyrians) Isa 28:2 (|| חזָק ; ׳א לִבּוֺ = valiant, conqueror Amos 2:16 ; of וְא לֵבָב ׳חֲכַם כֹּחַ ׳י, Job 9:4 ; compare א ׳כֹּחַ 9:19 (see Di & RV), ׳א כֹּחַ Isa 40:26 read probably אֹמֶץ ( ᵐ5 ) (|| אוֺנִים רֹב ).

occurrences.englishText: Absalom sent for Ahithophel the Gilonite, David’s counselor, from his city, even from Giloh, while he was offering the sacrifices. The conspiracy was strong; for the people increased continually with Absalom.
God who is wise in heart, and mighty in strength:
If it is a matter of strength, behold, he is mighty!
Behold, the Lord has a mighty and strong one. Like a storm of hail, a destroying storm, and like a storm of mighty waters overflowing, he will cast them down to the earth with his hand.
Lift up your eyes on high,
and he who is courageous among the mighty will flee away naked on that day,”
